column1: # Game profile of Cytus α (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.0.6 = v393216). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# Unity 2018.2.18f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 6.4.2; subsdk0 is the movie module. Its sdk and subsdk0 are AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES' builds (010089B00D09C000), so no rewriter cut was needed;

# the one host addition is the touch_panel key. A touch game: it reads the touch screen in handheld mode only, so the profile starts handheld with the Tap layout, and reports Boost for the 1920x1080 draw size.
# It presents at interval 1 (60 fps). The profile started as the provisional one of scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py; every guessed key was kept as the boot measured it
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region (it asks for 3.14 GB, which fits with the default 64 MB of used memory)
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# Cytus α takes the touchscreen only in handheld mode (docked, a click on the Mac and a touch on the iPhone do nothing), so it starts handheld;
# Boost in handheld (a combination a Switch 1 never reports) gives the docked 1920x1080 draw size, and the game then takes touches against that size:
# with the hardware panel's 1280x720 coordinates every touch landed short toward the top left, so touch_panel reports 1920x1080
